description: How Python code that uses this library is type-checked. Copied into arduino/app_bricks/static/ at build time, shipped in the wheel and read by the App Lab editor and by the CI checks of app-bricks-py and app-bricks-examples: the library owns the rules, the tools own the environment (paths, interpreter, execution root).

app-bricks-py.description: The library checked against itself (task check:typing in app-bricks-py). Strict, so the public API carries complete and truthful annotations. Downgraded to warnings: the rules that mostly echo untyped third-party code (Unknown propagating through members, variables, arguments and lambdas, decorators from dependencies, missing stubs) and deprecations, which stay visible in the local check but do not count as errors.

api-user.description: Code written against the library API: the published examples (app-bricks-examples) and the apps edited in App Lab.
